_instructions.quick_start: Copy this file to Data/Config/LLM/ollama.json (or Portfolios/<PortfolioName>/LLM/ollama.json) to run free, 100% private, local models via Ollama (https://ollama.com).
prerequisites: 2. Pull your desired models: 'ollama pull llama3.3' or 'ollama pull qwen2.5:14b'
3. Start the Ollama server: 'ollama serve' (runs on http://localhost:11434)
_instructions.privacy_shield_compatibility: Because http://localhost:11434 is a loopback URL, AdvisorBot recognizes it as local and allows it to run under 'Local-Only' Privacy Shield mode without sending any data over the internet.

other_local_backends.lm_studio: Start LM Studio's Local Server on port 1234 and set 'api_base_url' to 'http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions'.
